request:
镜头 s29：纪录片空镜，时长 7 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-v75）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Sony FX6', 'S-Cinetone']）：Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary establishing shot on a long zoom lens, atmospheric haze
导演意图（自然语言）：长焦大远景，几乎固定，风雪掠过。木星占满了整个天空，冰原被染成暗橙色，远处一台熄火的发动机。环境声：低沉的风声、冰层的呻吟。
情绪：overwhelming, dreadful, silent
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：extreme wide shot on a long lens, locked-off with snow blowing across
景深与虚实：Deep focus, snow in the foreground streaked with motion blur.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Exterior wide shot from the frozen surface of the Earth looking up: the planet Jupiter fills almost the entire sky, its bands and the Great Red Spot terrifyingly close, staining the ice plain dull orange; silhouettes of a stalled planetary engine and a tiny transport truck on the horizon. Blocking lock: Jupiter fills the upper two thirds of the frame; the ice plain lies across the bottom; the stalled engine silhouette at frame right on the horizon.
Picture 2: the ice plain under a sky filled by Jupiter (location reference; role: location reference). Exterior wide shot from the frozen surface of the Earth looking up: the planet Jupiter fills almost the entire sky, its bands and the Great Red Spot terrifyingly close, staining the ice plain dull orange; a faint stream of atmosphere is being pulled from the Earth towards it; silhouettes of a stalled planetary engine and a tiny transport truck on the horizon.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：low howling wind, deep groaning of ice
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/tex-ice] 冰原与压顶的天体
[rules/lens/documentary-zoom] lens
[rules/size/extreme-wide-shot] size
[ours/sound-crisis] 声音：危机现场
[ours/cam-long-lens] 机位：长焦远观
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 7.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, extreme wide shot, locked-off tripod camera with fixed framing from extreme wide shot to extreme wide shot, no camera movement; the only motion is wind-driven snow crossing the frame. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: Jupiter fills the upper two thirds of the frame from edge to edge; the ice plain lies across the bottom; the stalled planetary engine silhouette and the tiny transport truck sit at frame right on the horizon; the foreground bottom edge carries a low drift of snow; frame left and centre are empty ice fading into haze. Start: a thin veil of snow lifts from the ice at frame left and begins to stream sideways. Middle: the gust thickens, horizontal snow streaks crossing the foreground and briefly softening the engine silhouette at frame right while the lower ice plain dissolves into deeper haze. End: the gust thins, the snow drops into a drifting haze, the engine silhouette and transport truck sharpen again, and the framing remains unchanged. Mood: overwhelming, dreadful, silent. Blur: deep focus; Jupiter and the ice horizon stay sharp while the foreground snow is streaked with motion blur. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Low howling wind across the ice plain, deep groaning of the ice sheet, dry snow hissing past the lens, a faint metallic creak from the stalled engine far off; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
